$comment: Curated tool catalog for /hyper:tools recommendations. Schema per tool: id, name, description, docs, repo, stacks[] (node|go|rust|python|any), aspects[] (lint|format|typecheck|test|security|ci|complexity|deps|docs|hooks|release), detect {config: [globs], bin} (both optional; absence means presence cannot be verified), notes (optional; conflicts and replacements). Read by scripts/hyper-recommend.sh.

tools.name: Biome
tools.description: Fast formatter + linter for JS/TS/JSON/CSS
tools.notes: replaces eslint+prettier; do not recommend alongside them

tools.name: ESLint
tools.description: Pluggable JS/TS linter, the ecosystem default
tools.notes: conflicts with biome and oxlint as the primary linter; pick one

tools.name: Prettier
tools.description: Opinionated code formatter for JS/TS/CSS/Markdown and more
tools.notes: biome and dprint cover the same job; do not run two formatters on the same files

tools.name: Oxlint
tools.description: Very fast Rust-based JS/TS linter from the oxc project
tools.notes: alternative to eslint (fewer rules, much faster); do not recommend alongside it

tools.name: Vitest
tools.description: Vite-native test runner with Jest-compatible API
tools.notes: jest is the incumbent alternative; one unit test runner per project

tools.name: Knip
tools.description: Finds unused files, dependencies, and exports in JS/TS projects

tools.name: Jest
tools.description: Widely used JS/TS test framework with snapshots and mocking built in
tools.notes: vitest is the faster alternative with a compatible API; one unit test runner per project

tools.name: Playwright
tools.description: Browser end-to-end testing across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit

tools.name: Husky
tools.description: Minimal git hooks manager for npm projects
tools.notes: lefthook and pre-commit fill the same role; pick one hooks manager

tools.name: commitlint
tools.description: Lints commit messages against conventional-commit rules
tools.notes: pairs with a hooks manager (husky/lefthook) and conventional-commit release tooling

tools.name: Changesets
tools.description: Versioning and changelog workflow for npm packages and monorepos
tools.notes: release-please covers the same job driven by commit messages instead of changeset files; pick one

tools.name: Syncpack
tools.description: Keeps dependency versions consistent across monorepo package.json files

tools.name: Madge
tools.description: Visualizes module dependency graphs and finds circular imports in JS/TS
tools.notes: complements knip: knip finds unused code, madge maps import structure

tools.name: publint
tools.description: Lints npm package publishing config (exports, types, ESM/CJS fields)

tools.name: Are the Types Wrong?
tools.description: Checks published npm packages for TypeScript resolution problems
tools.notes: complements publint: publint checks package fields, attw checks how consumers resolve the types

tools.name: TypeDoc
tools.description: API documentation generator for TypeScript from source and comments

tools.name: golangci-lint
tools.description: Aggregated Go linter runner (staticcheck, govet, and dozens more)
tools.notes: bundles staticcheck; running both separately is redundant

tools.name: Staticcheck
tools.description: Advanced Go static analysis (correctness, simplification, style)
tools.notes: already included in golangci-lint; standalone use only makes sense without it

tools.name: gofumpt
tools.description: Stricter drop-in replacement for gofmt

tools.name: govulncheck
tools.description: Official Go vulnerability scanner (reports only reachable vulns)

tools.name: revive
tools.description: Fast, configurable Go linter, drop-in replacement for golint
tools.notes: available as a golangci-lint linter; standalone use only makes sense without it

tools.name: gosec
tools.description: Scans Go AST for common security problems (SAST)
tools.notes: bundled in golangci-lint as the gosec linter; running both separately is redundant

tools.name: gotestsum
tools.description: Wraps go test with readable output, JUnit XML, and rerun-failures

tools.name: Mockery
tools.description: Generates type-safe mocks for Go interfaces

tools.name: Clippy
tools.description: Official Rust linter with hundreds of correctness and style lints

tools.name: rustfmt
tools.description: Official Rust code formatter

tools.name: cargo-audit
tools.description: Audits Cargo.lock against the RustSec advisory database
tools.notes: cargo-deny includes the same advisory check plus license/source policy

tools.name: cargo-deny
tools.description: Lints Cargo dependencies: advisories, licenses, bans, sources
tools.notes: superset of cargo-audit; running both is redundant

tools.name: cargo-nextest
tools.description: Faster Rust test runner with better output and flaky-test handling

tools.name: Ruff
tools.description: Extremely fast Python linter and formatter in one tool
tools.notes: covers what black+flake8+isort did; do not recommend those alongside it

tools.name: mypy
tools.description: The reference Python static type checker
tools.notes: pick one of mypy/pyright; two type checkers disagree more than they help

tools.name: Pyright
tools.description: Fast Python type checker from Microsoft (powers Pylance)
tools.notes: pick one of mypy/pyright; two type checkers disagree more than they help

tools.name: pytest
tools.description: De-facto standard Python test framework

tools.name: Bandit
tools.description: Finds common security issues in Python code (SAST)

tools.name: uv
tools.description: Fast Python package and project manager (lockfiles, venvs, tool runs)
tools.notes: poetry occupies the same role; one package manager per project

tools.name: Poetry
tools.description: Python dependency management and packaging with lockfiles
tools.notes: uv is the faster alternative; one package manager per project

tools.name: pip-audit
tools.description: PyPA tool that audits Python environments for known vulnerabilities

tools.name: Black
tools.description: The uncompromising Python code formatter
tools.notes: ruff format is a drop-in replacement; do not run both

tools.name: Pylint
tools.description: Thorough Python linter with deeper inference than most alternatives
tools.notes: ruff reimplements many pylint rules and is far faster; prefer ruff unless pylint-only checks are needed

tools.name: Hypothesis
tools.description: Property-based testing library for Python
tools.notes: complements pytest rather than replacing it

tools.name: pytest-cov
tools.description: Coverage reporting plugin for pytest (wraps coverage.py)

tools.name: tox
tools.description: Runs Python test suites across multiple environments and versions
tools.notes: nox is the python-configured alternative; pick one env matrix runner

tools.name: pdoc
tools.description: Zero-config API documentation generator for Python from docstrings

tools.name: Gitleaks
tools.description: Scans repos and history for hardcoded secrets

tools.name: Semgrep
tools.description: Multi-language SAST with a large open rule registry

tools.name: OSV-Scanner
tools.description: Scans lockfiles across ecosystems against the OSV vulnerability database

tools.name: Trivy
tools.description: Scanner for dependencies, container images, IaC, and secrets

tools.name: Renovate
tools.description: Automated dependency update PRs across ecosystems

tools.name: Lefthook
tools.description: Fast, language-agnostic git hooks manager
tools.notes: husky and pre-commit fill the same role; pick one hooks manager

tools.name: actionlint
tools.description: Static checker for GitHub Actions workflow files

tools.name: typos
tools.description: Fast source-code spell checker with a low false-positive rate
tools.notes: cspell covers the same job with bigger dictionaries but more noise; one spell checker is enough

tools.name: dprint
tools.description: Pluggable multi-language code formatter (TS/JSON/Markdown/TOML and more)
tools.notes: overlaps prettier and biome formatting; one formatter per file type

tools.name: release-please
tools.description: Automated release PRs and changelogs from conventional commits
tools.notes: changesets covers the same job for npm monorepos via changeset files; pick one

tools.name: ShellCheck
tools.description: Static analysis for shell scripts, catches quoting and portability bugs

tools.name: Hadolint
tools.description: Dockerfile linter that also runs ShellCheck on RUN instructions

tools.name: yamllint
tools.description: Linter for YAML syntax, key repetition, and cosmetic problems

tools.name: markdownlint-cli2
tools.description: Style and consistency linter for Markdown files

tools.name: CSpell
tools.description: Dictionary-based spell checker for code with per-language dictionaries
tools.notes: typos covers the same job with lower noise but smaller coverage; one spell checker is enough

tools.name: zizmor
tools.description: Static analysis for GitHub Actions security (injection, pwn requests, pinning)
tools.notes: complements actionlint: actionlint checks workflow correctness, zizmor checks security

tools.name: pre-commit
tools.description: Git hooks framework with a large registry of ready-made hooks
tools.notes: python-born but manages hooks for any language; lefthook and husky fill the same role, pick one

tools.name: Lizard
tools.description: Cyclomatic complexity analyzer for many languages (JS/TS, Go, Python, C, more)
tools.notes: golangci-lint bundles gocyclo/gocognit for Go; ruff bundles mccabe for Python
